items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: Red Mackey was on bass and banjo... And that's about all of that group that really went into the Owls.

ctx.x: Were the winds in there or just strings?

All strings, yes. All strings. I was going to tell you. Red Mackey was on bass and banjo. Frank Mackey is his name, they called him Red. Then Rene Jelpe was on banjo. They had Eblen Rau on violin, Roletishner on guitar, Monk Smith, did I mention him? No. Monk Smith on guitar and Uke. And they had about seven or eight in the crowd. But I realize now, looking back, that they really were much better than we were. But we had the pep and the zip, and we'd work up some kind of little singing things with it.…
Did you ever have any more lessons there during that period?
